title: AdsNet: A Graph Neural Network for Direct Adsorption Energy Prediction
title_zh: AdsNet：用于直接吸附能量预测的图神经网络
summary: 快速准确地预测吸附能对于高通量计算催化剂筛选至关重要，现有方法在评估速度（全图机器学习潜力）或几何灵敏度（基于协调的模型，如 alpha 方案）上进行了妥协。在这里，我们提出了 AdsNet，一种等变图神经网络，可以直接预测单次前向传递中的吸附能，该网络在仅限于吸附原子及其在截止半径内的直接表面邻居的局部图上运行。这种局部图公式将计算复杂性与系统总尺寸解耦，同时对连续几何特征（原子间距离和方向向量）进行编码，从而能够对局部键合环境中的细微变化敏感。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25646v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fast and accurate prediction of adsorption energies is critical for high-throughput computational catalyst screening, existing methods compromise either on evaluation speed (full-graph machine learning potentials) or geometric sensitivity (coordination-based models like the alpha-scheme). Here, we present AdsNet, an equivariant graph neural network that directly predicts adsorption energies in a single forward pass, which operates on a local graph restricted only to adsorbate atoms and its immediate surface neighbors within a cutoff radius. This local graph formulation decouples computational complexity from total system size while encoding continuous geometric features (interatomic distances and directional vectors) enabling sensitivity to subtle variations in local bonding environments. AdsNet adopts a message-passing architecture with scalar and vector node features over multiple interaction layers. Trained on AdsTraj, a dataset of 33,920 density functional theory (DFT) calculated structures spanning 26 transition metals and 6 adsorbates (H*, C*, O*, CO*, OH*, HOCO*), the model achieves an adsorption energy root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 0.032 eV and a force RMSE of 0.047 eV/A. Analytic forces obtained via automatic differentiation enable structure relaxation through a projected gradient descent algorithm with adaptive line search, eliminating entire geometry optimizations. Additionally, AdsNet uniquely decomposes predicted adsorption energies into contributions from individual atoms within the local adsorbate graph - an interpretability feature unattainable with conventional machine-learning potentials. AdsNet thus establishes an accurate, highly efficient, and interpretable framework for large-scale adsorption energy prediction and local interface relaxation across various material surfaces.

title: Assessing the Transferability of General-Purpose MachineLearning Interatomic Potentials for Heterogeneous Catalysis with HetCat26
title_zh: 使用HetCat26评估通用机器学习原子间势在多相催化中的可迁移性
summary: 基础机器学习原子间势（MLIP）有望在化学和材料科学的广泛领域实现接近密度泛函理论（DFT）的精度。然而，它们在描述与多相催化相关的体系和过程方面的性能仍未得到充分探索。本文介绍了HetCat26，这是一个基准测试集，旨在评估预训练的MLIP在催化建模的关键方面（包括表面能、金属-金属氧化物相互作用、吸附和催化反应网络）的表现。在对十八个基础模型进行评估后，我们发现，在现有通用材料基准上的表现只能弱弱地预测在HetCat26上的表现；
abstract: arXiv:2609.30621v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Foundation machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) promise near-density functional theory (DFT) accuracy across broad areas of chemistry and materials science. However, their performance in describing systems and processes relevant to heterogeneous catalysis remains underexplored. Here, we introduce HetCat26, a collection of benchmark tests designed to assess pre-trained MLIPs across key aspects of catalytic modeling, including surface energetics, metal-metal oxide interactions, adsorption, and catalytic reaction networks. Evaluating eighteen foundation models, we find that performance on existing general materials benchmarks is only weakly predictive of performance on HetCat26; transferability to heterogeneous catalysis cannot be inferred from these general benchmarks. Across the benchmark tests, current models describe surface energetics and, perhaps surprisingly, reaction barriers well, whereas larger errors are observed for adsorption, and DFT site preferences are often not reproduced. Three models, eSEN-30M-OAM, SevenNet-Omni-i12 and MACE-MH-1-OMAT, nevertheless achieve high accuracy across the properties evaluated. Beyond model benchmarking, HetCat26 highlights the importance of training data consistency: PBE and PBE+U calculations should not be mixed within a training set. Overall, we identify challenges limiting the transferability of current foundation MLIPs to heterogeneous catalysis and, more broadly, to chemical reactions at interfaces, providing guidance for the development of the next generation of foundation models.

title: High-Accuracy Neural-Network Quantum States via Randomized Real-Time Dynamics
title_zh: 通过随机实时动力学实现高精度神经网络量子态
summary: 神经网络量子态（NQS）在能量最小化过程中表现出收敛到基态的差异：虽然能量随变分波函数的误差二次收敛，但其他可观测量仅线性收敛，这限制了物理预测的准确性。在这里，我们展示了如何通过引入一种提高 NQS 准确性的新算法来缩小这一差距。我们的方法称为动态平均，通过对实时演变的状态（或可观察的）进行平均来估计期望值。利用量子信息的见解，我们证明了任意基态可观测量中误差的高达二次抑制，从而匹配能量的快速收敛。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26587v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Neural-network quantum states (NQSs) exhibit a disparity in converging to the ground state during energy minimization: while the energy converges quadratically with the error in the variational wave function, other observables converge only linearly, which limits the accuracy of physical predictions. Here we show how to close this gap by introducing a new algorithm that improves the accuracy of NQSs. Our method, termed dynamical averaging, estimates expectation values by averaging over a state (or observable) evolved in real-time. Using insights from quantum information, we prove an up-to-quadratic suppression of error in arbitrary ground state observables, thus matching the fast convergence of the energy. Importantly, this improved accuracy requires neither further energy minimization nor increased model complexity, but rather exploits the effect of randomization on quantum states. We demonstrate dynamical averaging on non-integrable spin models, where it accelerates convergence and substantially reduces errors in observables.

title: Non-Abelian quantum Hall states at strong Landau level mixing: finding anyons with first-principles AI
title_zh: 强朗道能级混合下的非阿贝尔量子霍尔态：使用第一性原理人工智能寻找任意子
summary: 非阿贝尔任意子是构成容错拓扑量子计算基础的奇异粒子，据预测，它们会在偶数分母填充因子的分数量子霍尔态中出现。事实证明，确定实现了哪种拓扑序是一个具有挑战性的问题，需要对真实的朗道能级混合进行准确的非微扰处理，而这迄今为止在理论研究中尚付阙如。本文首次提出了非阿贝尔量子霍尔问题的完整解，该解包括所有电子和所有朗道能级，适用于填充因子ν = 3/2的自旋极化电子。我们开发了一种动量分辨的神经网络变分波函数，该波函数仅在微观哈密顿量上进行优化，从而可以直接获得拓扑简并基态。
abstract: arXiv:2610.18967v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Non-Abelian anyons, strange particles forming the basis of fault-tolerant topological quantum computing, are predicted to emerge in fractional quantum Hall states at even-denominator filling factors. Identifying which topological order is realized has proven to be a challenging problem that requires an accurate, non-perturbative treatment of realistic Landau level mixing, which has so far been missing from theoretical studies. Here we present the first complete solution of non-Abelian quantum Hall problem that includes all electrons and all Landau levels, for spin-polarized electrons at filling factor ν = 3/2. We develop a momentum-resolved neural-network variational wave function, optimized solely on the microscopic Hamiltonian, which gives direct access to the topologically degenerate ground states. Without any physics input about the expected outcome, it discovers a degenerate ground-state manifold whose entanglement reveals anyons with quantum dimension sqrt2, the hallmark of Ising-type non-Abelian order. By directly computing the overlap with trial wave functions, we further show that Landau level mixing favors the anti-Pfaffian over other candidate states. Our results demonstrate the power of neural-network wave functions in finding and characterizing non-Abelian anyons from first principles, in regimes of strong Landau level mixing, relevant to many recent experiments.

title: The phase diagram of fluid hydrogen near melting from machine-learned interatomic potentials trained on quantum Monte Carlo
title_zh: 根据量子蒙特卡罗训练的机器学习原子间势绘制接近熔化状态的液态氢相图
summary: 随着温度或压力的升高，分子氢的解离可以通过相变逐渐或突然发生。尽管进行了大量的实验和理论工作，但在高于固体熔化的温度下稠密氢的相图仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用两个机器学习的原子间势对稠密氢进行经典和量子路径积分分子动力学模拟，这两个原子间势均经过量子蒙特卡罗能量和力的训练。由此产生的相图是使用最先进的技术构建的。两个模型都显示了从分子到原子液体的一级相变，终止于临界点，其位置是使用有限尺寸缩放技术确定的。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25178v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dissociation of molecular hydrogen increasing temperature or pressure may either occur gradually or abruptly, via a phase transition. Despite considerable experimental and theoretical efforts, the phase diagram of dense hydrogen at temperatures above solid melting is not precisely known. Here, we perform classical and quantum Path Integral molecular dynamics simulations of dense hydrogen using two machine-learned interatomic potentials both trained on quantum Monte Carlo energies and forces. The resulting phase diagram is constructed using state-of-the-art techniques. Both models show a first-order phase transition from the molecular to the atomic liquid terminating in critical points whose locations were determined using finite-size scaling techniques. Triple points, located at the highest temperature of the melting curve, are found at the intersection of the liquid-liquid lines with the melting curve and should lead to clear signatures in ramp compression experiments.

title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
title_zh: Perfumer：基于大型语言模型的代理框架，加速第一原理计算的结构松弛和电子频带预测
summary: 第一原理结构松弛和能带计算需要大量的计算和专业知识。在这里，我们介绍 Perfumer，一个基于大型语言模型的代理框架，它将 Quantum ESPRESSO 与两个预测模型结合起来。在测试的结构中，使用 Perfumer-relax 模型进行预松弛，然后进行 QE 细化，其总体加速比单独使用 QE 提高了 2.75 倍。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. Trained on 125,153 self-curated band structures, Perfumer-band model reaches a median per-material mean absolute error of 0.157 eV on 2,607 test materials, including lanthanide, actinide and magnetic compounds, from held-out composition families spanning 85 elements, taking about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores. The agent turns natural-language requests into relaxation-to-band workflows, from a single uploaded structure to automatically constructed new candidates and returns predicted properties.

title: Encoding Orbital-Projected Densities of States in Graph Neural Networks for Materials Property Prediction
title_zh: 在图神经网络中编码轨道投影状态密度以进行材料特性预测
summary: 图神经网络已成为从晶体结构预测材料特性的主要机器学习架构。然而，原子节点特征的初始化相对较少受到关注，传统方法依赖于静态元素描述符，这些描述符不携带有关其晶体主体中每个原子的量子力学电子环境的信息。在这里，我们表明，通过直接从密度泛函理论计算计算出的位点投影轨道态密度（pDOS）指纹来增强原子节点表示，可以在预测性能方面产生系统性和实质性的改进。在消息传递之前，这些表示与每个原子位点的 Pettifor 元素嵌入融合。
abstract: arXiv:2607.07339v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Graph neural networks have become the dominant machine-learning architecture for predicting materials properties from crystal structures. Yet the initialization of atomic node features has received comparatively little attention, and conventional approaches rely on static elemental descriptors that carry no information about the quantum-mechanical electronic environment of each atom in its crystalline host. Here we show that augmenting atomic node representations with site-projected orbital density of states (pDOS) fingerprints, computed directly from density functional theory calculations, yields systematic and substantial improvements in predictive performance.These representations are fused with Pettifor elemental embeddings at each atomic site before message passing. For the superconducting critical temperature T_c and the optical dielectric constant ϵᵢₙfₜy,the pDOS augmentation reduces prediction errors by 22.9% and 27.9%, respectively, relative to the elemental-descriptor baseline. These improvements are comparable to those achieved by doubling the training-set size. The gains are, however, contingent on training-set size. For the magnetic exchange energies of Heusler compounds, a substantially smaller dataset, the improvement is reduced,indicating that pDOS augmentation is most effective when the training data exceeds the length of the pDOS feature vector. We introduce an interpretable spectral attention-gating mechanism that reveals that the model autonomously learns to prioritize the orbital channels and energy windows most physically relevant to each target property. These results establish pDOS-augmented graph nodes as a broadly applicable strategy for infusing first-principles electronic-structure knowledge into graph networks, opening a practical route to high-accuracy property prediction in data-scarce regimes.

title: Machine learning insight into porous carbon materials
title_zh: 机器学习洞察多孔碳材料
summary: 出版日期：2027 年 1 月 来源：计算材料科学，第 276 卷 作者：Alina A. Chubarova、Darya A. Sergeicheva、Mikhail V. Trenikhin、Olga A. Knyazheva、Aleksandr V. Lavrenov、Pavel V. Prudnikov
abstract: Publication date: January 2027 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 276 Author(s): Alina A. Chubarova, Darya A. Sergeicheva, Mikhail V. Trenikhin, Olga A. Knyazheva, Aleksandr V. Lavrenov, Pavel V. Prudnikov

title: Learning Spin Hamiltonians from Interacting Magnon Spectra
title_zh: 从相互作用磁振子谱中学习自旋哈密顿量
summary: 学习逆映射的神经网络继承了用于生成其训练数据的正向求解器的近似值。我们通过合成中子散射谱的自旋哈密顿量推理证明了这一点，并展示了快速多体求解器如何克服线性自旋波理论（LSWT）的局限性。我们考虑在略高于饱和度的场上的一系列各向异性三角晶格自旋哈密顿量，其中磁振子相互作用以 LSWT 无法捕获的方式移动并拓宽光谱。使用截断希尔伯特空间阶梯（THL）方法，我们在一磁振子空间和二磁振子空间内非微扰地计算动态自旋结构因子（DSSF）。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A neural network that learns an inverse map inherits the approximations of the forward solver used to generate its training data. We demonstrate this in the inference of spin Hamiltonians from synthetic neutron-scattering spectra and show how a fast many-body solver can overcome the limitation of linear spin-wave theory (LSWT). We consider a family of anisotropic triangular-lattice spin Hamiltonians at fields just above saturation, where magnon interactions shift and broaden the spectrum in ways that LSWT cannot capture. Using the truncated Hilbert-space ladder (THL) method, we compute the dynamical spin structure factor (DSSF) nonperturbatively within the one- and two-magnon space. THL is fast enough to generate large training sets of DSSF spectra, enabling us to train neural networks that accurately predict Hamiltonian parameters. By empirically benchmarking several neural-network architectures, we find that a one-dimensional convolutional network performs best. A learned forward decoder then reconstructs the DSSF from the predicted parameters, providing a rapid self-consistency check and a visualization of the predicted response. When interactions are strong, networks trained on LSWT and THL spectra infer markedly different parameters. Analysis of the Fisher information matrix shows that the measurement protocol, including which spin-correlation components are resolved and the momentum cut, determines which couplings can be identified. Combining machine learning with fast many- body theory is therefore essential for quantitative Hamiltonian inference from scattering data.

title: Emergent Fatigue Dynamics from Foundational Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 基础原子间势的突现疲劳动力学
summary: 基础机器学习原子间势是在大型、多样化的 DFT 数据集上进行训练的，但它们的验证依赖于平衡状态，这并不能保证大规模分子动力学中正确的涌现行为。在没有直接实验验证的情况下，与物理激励潜力的比较对于获得洞察力很有价值。我们区分静态属性（可热访问）和紧急属性（需要外部疲劳应力来驱动罕见事件），并比较两者的潜力。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26533v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundational machine-learned interatomic potentials are trained on large, diverse DFT datasets, but their validation rests on equilibrium states, which does not guarantee correct emergent behavior in large-scale molecular dynamics. Where no direct experimental validation is available, comparisons to physically motivated potentials are valuable for drawing insight. We distinguish static properties, which are thermally accessible, from emergent properties, which require work from an external fatigue stress to drive rare events, and compare the potentials on both. An EAM potential and the NequIP foundational potential both agree closely with reference data for many near-equilibrium properties, but NequIP predicts an anomalously low intrinsic stacking fault energy (sim7 times lower than EAM) and thus predicts far more plastic deformation under fatigue cycling of a nanoscale flaw modeled after the classical Griffith crack problem. Per-atom energy distributions after loading show that the two potentials differ most at energies far above what is thermally accessible. We also document memory-related crashes and silent extrapolation as practical concerns for practitioners of these foundational model forms.

title: Machine Learning-Driven High-Throughput Screening of Equimolar and Non-Equimolar High-Entropy Carbides
title_zh: 机器学习驱动的等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物的高通量筛选
summary: 由于成分空间较大，无法通过实验或从头计算进行测试，因此在高熵陶瓷中寻找最佳成分具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出了 IVB 和 VB 族过渡金属（Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta）中等摩尔和非等摩尔高熵碳化物 (HEC) 的高通量筛选。大型原子模型 MACE 和基于从头开始的结构数据集训练的基于深度学习的原子间势 DeePMD 用于有效筛选 Ti、Zr、Hf、V、Nb 和 Ta 过渡金属高熵碳化物中的数千种潜在非等摩尔成分。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25127v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Search for optimal compositions among high-entropy ceramics are challenging due to large composition space, which are unable to test either experimentally or by ab initio calculations. Here we present a high-throughput screening for equimolar and non-equimolar high-entropy carbides (HEC) among group IVB and VB transition metals (Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta). Large Atomistic Model MACE, and deep learning based interatomic potential DeePMD trained on ab initio-based dataset of structures are used to effectively screen over the thousands of potential non-equimolar compositions among high-entropy carbides of Ti, Zr, Hf, V, Nb and Ta transition metals. A set of both equimolar and non-equimolar HECs are predicted to be stable in order to further synthesize those compositions based on the predictions.

title: Alloying effects on the interface cohesion of grain boundaries in the Ni--Fe--Cr system
title_zh: 合金化对Ni--Fe--Cr系晶界界面凝聚力的影响
summary: 多晶镍基合金中的晶界 (GB) 强烈影响机械强度和断裂行为，但 Fe 和 Cr 等合金元素对晶界内聚力的影响仍然难以系统量化。使用密度泛函理论 (DFT)，我们计算了六个对称倾斜 Ni GB 的刚体分离 (RBS) 曲线，通过通用结合能关系 (UBER) 提取分离功 Wₛₑₚ 和最大牵引力 σₘₐₓ。我们发现，相对于纯镍晶界，将 Cr 或 Fe 替换到晶界平面中会增加这两个量。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25944v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline Ni-based alloys strongly influence mechanical strength and fracture behavior, yet the effect of alloying elements such as Fe and Cr on GB cohesion remains difficult to quantify systematically. Using density functional theory (DFT), we compute rigid-body separation (RBS) curves for six symmetric-tilt Ni GBs, extracting the work of separation Wₛₑₚ and maximum traction σₘₐₓ via the universal binding energy relation (UBER). We find that substitution of Cr or Fe into the GB plane increases both quantities relative to pure Ni GBs. To overcome the size limitations of DFT, we compare several machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) foundation models against the DFT dataset and identify a model achieving quantitative agreement with DFT for Wₛₑₚ and σₘₐₓ. This MLIP enables systematic sampling of alloying configurations at finer concentration steps. We show that alloying-induced changes in GB cohesion depend on both, element type and local structures, revealing trends that are inaccessible with DFT alone. Extending the analysis to a ternary Ni₅₆Fe₂₀Cr₂₄ composition, inspired by the principal constituents of the widely used commercial Alloy 718, shows that the binary trends provide a useful basis for interpreting the combined effect of both substitutes, while explicit ternary calculations are required to capture their interplay quantitatively. Together, these results provide a validated workflow for quantifying the effect of alloying elements on GB cohesion in multicomponent alloys. The resulting values may serve as input for continuum-scale fracture models, paving the way toward atomistically informed multiscale modeling.

title: Probing the limits of materials design via a comprehensive crystal database of 14.6 million structures with 140 properties
title_zh: 通过包含1460万种结构和140种性质的综合性晶体数据库，探索材料设计的极限
summary: 正向筛选和逆向设计推动了材料的发现，但由于已知晶体结构和性质的记录分散在各个数据库中，因此其局限性仍未得到量化。因此，正向筛选导致已知晶体的新功能未得到充分探索，而生成式和自主发现则屡次将已知相或近似变体报告为新材料。在这里，我们对55个数据库中的结构进行匹配，以构建MateriaViva，这是一个包含1460万种不同晶体和超过10亿个属性值的统一数据库。
abstract: arXiv:2610.32678v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Forward screening and inverse design drive materials discovery, yet their limits remain unquantified because records of known crystal structures and properties are fragmented across databases. Consequently, forward screening leaves known crystals underexplored for new functions, whereas generative and autonomous discovery has repeatedly reported known phases or close variants as new materials. Here we match structures across 55 databases to assemble MateriaViva, a unified database of 14.6 million distinct crystals and over one billion property values. To provide the missing properties of every structure, a task we term property completion, we develop an equivariant Crystal Graph Transformer Network with state-of-the-art accuracy on nine benchmark tasks and apply 140 property-prediction models across the database. These predictions reveal the underestimated potential of forward screening, identifying tens of thousands of high-performance candidates among previously synthesized or computationally studied materials that lack recorded target-property values. Conversely, comparison with MateriaViva shows that the novelty of inverse design has been overestimated, as 55-100% of inverse-designed structures are not new. Under equal density functional theory verification budgets for bulk-modulus design, inverse design yields a higher fraction of qualifying candidates, whereas forward screening reaches the higher bulk modulus. MateriaViva thus provides a comprehensive reference for probing the limits of both paradigms, revealing unrecognized performance in known crystals and directing inverse design beyond reported structures.

title: Reward misalignment as an opportunity for materials discovery
title_zh: 奖励错位作为材料发现的机会
summary: 奖励失调通常被视为人工智能的失败。然而，在使用生成式人工智能模型进行材料发现时，预定义奖励与专家判断之间的不一致可能会揭示奖励忽略的材料。我们使用电子平带作为主要示例来研究这种可能性。专家们大多同意数字带宽分数，但他们的分歧是系统性的，不能用估计的 5% 错误标签率来解释。我们通过成对比较了解专家的偏好，并用它们来指导晶体扩散模型。学习到的偏好和数值分数在最平坦的带上一致，但在其他地方有所不同。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26186v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reward misalignment is usually regarded as a failure of artificial intelligence. In materials discovery with generative AI models, however, disagreement between predefined rewards and expert judgment may reveal materials that the rewards overlook. We investigate this possibility using electronic flat bands as a prime example. Experts mostly agree with a numerical bandwidth score, but their disagreements are systematic and cannot be explained by an estimated 5% rate of mistaken labels. We learn the experts' preferences from pairwise comparisons and use them to guide a crystal diffusion model. The learned preferences and numerical score agree on the flattest bands but diverge elsewhere. For example, the preferences favor KCo2As2 and CoGa, reported compounds with partially flat bands that the score would discard. The framework also extends to synthesizability and phonon properties. Our findings suggest that reward misalignment can expose opportunities for materials discovery beyond what fixed rewards are designed to find.

title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Fermions with Neural Gaussian Tensor Networks
title_zh: 使用神经高斯张量网络对强相关费米子进行可扩展模拟
summary: 强相关电子的精确模拟仍然是计算物理学的核心挑战。我们引入了神经网络高斯投影纠缠对态 (NN-GPEPS)，它利用高斯态的局部纠缠子空间来提供与现代神经网络更兼容的架构，并在二维晶格上实现 O(N3/2) 的精确收缩成本。对于 U/t=8 和 1/8 孔掺杂的 Hubbard 模型，我们在多达 1024 个位点的大晶格中获得了最先进的变分能量。这些结果证明了通过将神经网络与高斯张量网络连接来实现强相关费米子的准确方法。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate simulations of strongly correlated electrons remain a central challenge in computational physics. We introduce neural-network Gaussian projected entangled-pair states (NN-GPEPS), which exploit the locally-entangled subspace of Gaussian states to give an architecture more compatible with modern neural networks and an exact contraction cost of O(N³/²) on two-dimensional lattices. For the Hubbard model at U/t=8 and 1/8 hole doping, we obtain state-of-the-art variational energies in large lattices of up to 1024 sites. These results demonstrate an accurate approach to strongly correlated fermions by connecting neural networks with Gaussian tensor networks.

title: FamilySpace: From Emergent Chemical Semantics to Controllable Crystal Generation
title_zh: FamilySpace：从新兴化学语义到可控晶体生成
summary: 潜在晶体生成模型通常将用于学习原子级表示的变分自动编码器（VAE）与将简单源分布传输到学习的潜在分布的流模型相结合。然而，以前的研究主要集中在生成的晶体的质量上，而原子潜在空间的结构和生成效用在很大程度上尚未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们表明，即使是普通晶体 VAE 也会根据元素族隐式组织原子潜在表示，不同族占据潜在空间的大部分独立区域。我们将这种现象称为新兴化学语义。这种结构表明，从特定族的潜在区域采样可以使解码器偏向来自相应元素族的原子。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25452v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Latent crystal generative models typically combine a variational autoencoder (VAE) for learning atom-wise representations with a flow model that transports a simple source distribution to the learned latent distribution. However, previous studies have mainly focused on the quality of generated crystals, leaving the structure and generative utility of the atom-wise latent space largely unexplored. In this work, we show that even a vanilla crystal VAE implicitly organizes atom-wise latent representations according to elemental families, with different families occupying largely separated regions of the latent space. We term this phenomenon emergent chemical semantics. This structure suggests that sampling from a family-specific latent region can bias the decoder toward atoms from the corresponding elemental family. Building on this insight, we propose FamilySpace, a framework for controlling the elemental-family composition of generated crystals. FamilySpace assigns each elemental family a distinct source component, forming a family-indexed multi-source distribution, and trains a flow model using source-target pairs matched by family. In inference, a user-specified family template selects the source component for each atom-wise representation, enabling direct control over the family composition of generated crystals. Experiments on MP-20 and MPTS-52 show that FamilySpace achieves competitive crystal-generation performance while matching prescribed elemental-family compositions. Moreover, selected family templates increase the fraction of generated crystals predicted to be stable or metastable, demonstrating that latent-space composition control can support targeted exploration of promising chemical regions without additional optimization techniques such as reinforcement learning. Code is available at https://github.com/hhw11/FamilySpace

title: From power to spectrum: an off-the-shelf photodiode turned into a spectrometer by its bias alone
title_zh: 从功率到光谱：现成的光电二极管仅通过其偏置就变成了光谱仪
summary: 计算光谱仪用光谱响应可以变化的探测器取代色散光学，但每个报道的单探测器设备都通过专用制造获得这种响应：二维异质结构、分级外延结、有机堆栈、滤波器或光子电路。我们展示了一种通用的、免制造的替代方案，其中标准商用光电二极管仅通过其电力驱动即可成为光谱仪，无需修改设备，无需滤光片，也无需对光进行调制。其机制是偏置调制光电色散（OED）：不同波长的光在不同深度被吸收，正弦偏置改变了每个深度产生的载流子的收集方式，以便每个光谱在一个偏置周期内被编码为光电流波形的形状。
abstract: arXiv:2611.26532v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational spectrometers replace dispersive optics with detectors whose spectral response can be varied, but every reported single-detector device obtains this response through dedicated fabrication: two-dimensional heterostructures, graded epitaxial junctions, organic stacks, filters or photonic circuits. We demonstrate a generic, fabrication-free alternative in which a standard commercial photodiode becomes a spectrometer through its electrical drive alone, requiring no modification of the device, no optical filter and no modulation of the light. The mechanism is bias-modulated optoelectronic chromatic dispersion (OED): light of different wavelengths is absorbed at different depths, and a sinusoidal bias changes how carriers generated at each depth are collected, so that every spectrum is encoded in the shape of the photocurrent waveform over one bias period. Applied to an unmodified InGaAs PIN photodiode at room temperature, a 10 us waveform decoded by a neural network reconstructs spectra of one to three laser lines across the 80 nm of the telecom C+L band, locating the lines to 0.3-0.4 nm, counting them in about 99% of measurements and identifying their power levels, with line shifts tracked to tens of picometres. Because OED relies on universal semiconductor transport physics, the approach is material-agnostic and applies in principle to any off-the-shelf photodiode, turning detectors already deployed as power monitors into low-cost spectral sensors.

title: Josephson effect in bipolar magnetic semiconductors
title_zh: 双极磁性半导体中的约瑟夫森效应
summary: 我们从理论上研究了包含双极磁性半导体 (BMS) 的一维约瑟夫森结中的平衡电流。我们证明，自旋分辨带的固有交换分裂可以通过 BMS 化学势的栅极可调调制来实现 0--π 跃迁的纯电控制，从而无需外部磁场。这为实现电可调 π 结行为提供了一条可行的途径，并凸显了基于 BMS 的约瑟夫森器件在相控超导电子器件方面的潜力。此外，在存在 Rashba 自旋轨道耦合的情况下，我们发现了异常约瑟夫森效应，其特征是零相位差下的有限平衡超流。
abstract: arXiv:2608.24322v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We theoretically investigate equilibrium currents in a one-dimensional Josephson junction incorporating a bipolar magnetic semiconductor (BMS). We show that the intrinsic exchange splitting of the spin-resolved bands enables purely electrical control of the 0--π transition through gate-tunable modulation of the BMS chemical potential, eliminating the need for an external magnetic field. This provides a viable route toward electrically tunable π-junction behavior and highlights the potential of BMS-based Josephson devices for phase-controllable superconducting electronics. Furthermore, in the presence of Rashba spin--orbit coupling, we find an anomalous Josephson effect characterized by a finite equilibrium supercurrent at zero phase difference. This behavior originates from the intrinsic breaking of time-reversal symmetry associated with the spin-polarized electronic structure of the BMS. Interestingly, despite the simultaneous breaking of time-reversal and inversion symmetries---conditions often associated with nonreciprocal superconducting transport---we do not observe a Josephson diode effect. Our results therefore highlight an important distinction between anomalous Josephson transport and superconducting nonreciprocity: the former does not necessarily imply a finite critical-current asymmetry between opposite current directions.

title: Ab-initio study of magnetic interaction in RNiO2: role of rare-earth size and epitaxial strain
title_zh: RNiO2 中磁相互作用的从头算研究：稀土尺寸和外延应变的作用
summary: 在本文中，我们对不同基底约束下无限层 RNiO2 薄膜系列（R = La-Lu）的结构和最近邻磁交换相互作用进行了系统的第一性原理研究。首先采用密度泛函理论计算来优化晶体结构，同时使用CAS+DDCI相关波函数计算来确定磁交换。该方法允许获得与 RIXS 实验估计非常一致的磁相互作用。在原始情况下，我们的结果证实了 RNiO2 的结构（R = La 和 Ce 除外）采用 I4/mcm 空间群，其特征是 NiO4 板的面外旋转。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25907v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we present a systematic first-principles investigation of the structure and nearest-neighbor magnetic exchange interactions in the infinite-layer RNiO2 thin-film series (R = La-Lu), under the constrain of different substrates. Density functional theory calculations are first employed to optimize the crystal structures, while CAS+DDCI correlated wave-function calculations were used for the determination of the magnetic exchanges. This methodology allows to obtain magnetic interactions in good agreement with RIXS experimental estimations. In the pristine case, our results confirm that the structure of RNiO2 (except for R = La and Ce) adopts the I4/mcm space group, characterized by an out-of-plane rotation of the NiO4 plaquettes. This result remains valid under substrate constrains, even if compressive strain reduces the amplitude of the rotational distortion and leads to an enhancement of the magnetic exchange interaction relative to the pristine structures. The latter are found to depend sensitively on both the rare-earth ionic radius and the applied epitaxial strain. These results highlight the role of structural distortions and substrate-induced strain in tuning magnetic interactions in infinite-layer nickelates.

title: Anyon Coherent States in Fractional Chern Insulators
title_zh: 分数陈绝缘体中的任意子相干态
summary: 在分数量子霍尔（FQH）系统中，相干任意子激发是描述任意子动力学、它们的相互作用和编织的自然实体，但除了劳克林准空穴之外，尚无其波函数的通用表达式。我们引入了一种系统的、基于算子的构造，对 FQH 态和分数陈绝缘体中任一电荷的任意子的最大局域波函数进行构建，包括非理想、不可涡旋带中的那些。我们发现这些波函数描述了相干准粒子：使投影密度不确定性界限饱和的局域湮没算子的零模式。这些相干态的存在归功于任意子带的非平凡拓扑，其布洛赫系数的缠绕编码了任意子带的陈数。
abstract: arXiv:2611.25034v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In fractional quantum Hall (FQH) systems, coherent anyonic excitations are the natural entities for describing anyon dynamics, their interactions, and braiding, yet no general expression for their wavefunctions is known beyond Laughlin's quasiholes. We introduce a systematic, operator-based construction of maximally-localized wavefunctions of anyons of either charge in FQH states and fractional Chern insulators, including those in non-ideal, non-vortexable bands. We find that these wavefunctions describe coherent quasiparticles: zero modes of local annihilation operators that saturate projected-density uncertainty bounds. These coherent states owe their existence to a nontrivial topology of the anyon band, with the winding of their Bloch coefficients encoding an anyon band's Chern number. As such, their guiding centers exist anywhere within the lattice, and their mutual overlaps decay as Gaussians determined by the effective magnetic length of the anyon band.
